title: Brisbane, Queensland — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Brisbane, Queensland: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Brisbane is a city in Queensland with a population of 2,568,927. Queensland’s sunny capital with a laid-back lifestyle, riverfront dining, and gateway to the Gold Coast. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 261 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
